name: Cloudflare WAF Documentation Glossary
description: Cloudflare WAF Documentation Glossary — 16 terms scoped to Cloudflare's Web Application Firewall product documentation (allowlist, attack score, paranoia level, leaked credentials, prompt injection, etc.). Tightly focused — distinct from the broader Fundamentals glossary.
relationToCloudSecurity: Direct — WAF-specific terminology, all cloud-security relevant.
relationToAISecurity: Direct — includes prompt-injection and LLM-as-firewall-target entries.

license.notes: Cloudflare states that all documentation on its developer documentation website is licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/reference/policies-compliances/licenses/, checked 2026-11-14). This record follows the website's statement, which covers the pages this glossary was taken from and is also the stricter of the two: attribute Cloudflare, and share derived data (the term files here) under CC BY-SA 4.0. Publicly accessible web resource with no login required (Tier 2 of Kurt Seifried 2026-11-09 4-tier hosting rule: open-web no-login content is mirrored in the public dataset repository with attribution).
